title: TTRPG Codex language pack v1
description: The pack.json manifest of a language pack: a data-only ZIP holding one language's translation of one add-on for a range of its versions. The pack holds pack.json, the declared catalog and the declared content files, nothing else.

locale.description: A canonical BCP 47 tag other than English, which every package must ship.

addonVersions.description: Add-on versions the pack applies to, as a semantic version range such as ">=3.6.0 <4.0.0". It must include builtFrom.

builtFrom.description: The add-on version whose English catalog the pack was checked against.

catalog.description: The language's message-catalog.v1 file. The host merges it with the package's own catalog for the language, package messages first.

content.description: Reserved for content translation overlays, such as record overlays of a content set. The host stores and validates the files but does not apply them yet.
